chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadah from 'Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The deceased is prayed over as long as he has not been buried in the earth, even if the funeral prayer has already been performed upon him.
ai.seo_question: Can the funeral prayer be performed again if the body has not yet been buried?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the temporal validity of Salat al-Janazah, establishing that the prayer remains legally effective until the body is fully interred, even if performed previously. This ruling provides flexibility for communities to perform the prayer for a deceased person who has not yet been buried, ensuring the spiritual benefit reaches the soul regardless of prior rituals.
